prompt: Eye level on a 28mm lens, at a stopped 1920s assembly line of black Model T bodies receding in a long row of hard perspective behind a Polish American factory hand of about 30. Broad, flat-cheeked face, snub nose, pale stubble, flat cap pushed back, thick neck in an open grey work shirt. He stands three-quarter on, close enough that his head and shoulders take the left half of the frame, singing flatly into the lens, arms hanging. Overhead, a mercury lamp casts sickly green down the line and over his face. A caged red warning lamp on a post beyond him throws a turning red beam across the bodies. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
